data.name: Unstuck Kelvin
data.shortDescription: Press K to teleport Kelvin in front of you.
data.description:
Description Kelvin keeps getting stuck. Press K to teleport him in front of you. Installation instructions - Install RedLoader if you haven't already. - Unzip to your game's main folder (where SonsOfTheForest.exe is located) maintaining the ZIP's folder structure. (The .DLL will end up under the Mods folder, and the .json under the Mods/RW18_unstuckKelvin folder.)

Main features Press K to teleport Kelvin in front of you when he gets stuck.

Requirements Must have RedLoader installed.
